title: Simply Java Block
description: Minecraft has a Bedrock block but no Java block? Bro, that’s unfair. This mod adds a Java Block, Simply!
body:
# Ever felt Minecraft was unbalanced? Now it’s fair:
# 
Bedrock Block → the classic OG block.

Java Block ☕ → now available with this mod!

............................................................................

Craftable, placeable, and ready to flex across all supported versions.

Tough like iron (or obsidian if you go full meme), but sounds like stone.

Cheap & funny crafting recipe: cocoa beans + glass bottles + stick.

# Features:
# 
Multiple version support

Meme-energy block for Java Edition fans

Decorative but slightly resistant → shows “Java power”

Fair gameplay 😂 


# HOW TO CRAFT IT?
